Title: AI Usage / Cost Dashboard
Summary: A read-only operator-facing AI analytics dashboard answering the brief's ten questions (spend, on what, verified results, cheap-but-retry routes, failure cost, escalation cost, true cost per verified success, savings, budgets approaching limits, provider failures driving waste). Single HTML artifact, self-contained in DB-M26-owned files; every number derives READ-ONLY from the existing foundations, never a divergent alternate metric. Total/Actual/Estimated-pending spend is DB-M16 semantics via the DB-M25 reporting pass (S01/S02/S06); verified-success is authoritative (a model self-PASS with failed verification is CONTRADICTED, never success; S07); attempt-chain cost is the DB-M25 chain cost (fail 3 + fail 6 + pass 10 = 19 cumulative 3/9/19; S05); failed-attempt cost, escalation cost (3+6) and correction cost (full multi-attempt chain) are each visible and drillable (S08-S12); first-attempt success rate and cost per verified success are shown (S13/S14); savings always carry the explicit baseline type/basis + observed cost-per-success on both sides + confidence + sample (S15/S16); confidence reuses DB-M24 bands and INSUFFICIENT is labelled everywhere (S17); filters cover task type/provider/model/reasoning/date window (S18-S22); direct vs gateway stay separate with the underlying model preserved (S23/S24); LOCAL is never invented as FREE (LOCAL_COST_UNKNOWN; S25); budget WARNING/BLOCKED is displayed from the policy thresholds and the dashboard never grants overrides (S26/S27/S37); provider health + circuit state are displayed from the passed snapshot and never polled (S28/S29/S38); failed attempts remain visible after later success (S30/S32); chain drilldown carries cumulative cost (S31); zero write actions, zero provider/model execution, zero pricing/router/budget/health mutation, zero network calls, zero paid calls (S33-S40); the canonical Nexus workbook and all 18 M12.x UI source files are SHA-256 verified byte-identical (S41/S42); all DB-M14/M16/M17/M19/M20/M21/M22/M23/M24/M25 regressions stay green (S43/S44); build + schema validators pass on real artifacts (S45). AUTO_EXECUTION_ENABLED=FALSE; paid calls 0; network calls 0.
